title.en: Pipe roughness,hydraulic radius and hydraulic diameter
title.gu: Pipe Roughness,Hydraulic Radius અને Hydraulic Diameter

h.en: Pipe roughness,hydraulic radius and hydraulic diameter
h.gu: Pipe Roughness,Hydraulic Radius અને Hydraulic Diameter

body.en:
Definition and principle

Absolute roughness ε characterises surface asperity height; relative roughness is ε divided by hydraulic diameter. Hydraulic radius is flow area divided by wetted perimeter. Hydraulic diameter is four times hydraulic radius; it is a geometric scale, not the actual diameter of every noncircular passage.

Important points

For a full circular pipe, the hydraulic diameter equals its inside diameter; hydraulic radius equals one-fourth of that diameter. Count only perimeter in contact with the fluid, not a free surface. For a fully wetted concentric annulus, the hydraulic diameter is outer-flow diameter minus inner-solid diameter. Correlations for laminar noncircular flow retain shape dependence; do not universally apply 64/Re using Dh.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Absolute Roughness ε surface asperity ની characteristic height અને Relative Roughness એટલે ε ને hydraulic diameter થી ભાગતાં મળતું value. Hydraulic Radius flow area/wetted perimeter છે.Hydraulic Diameter તેનો ચાર ગણો છે; તે geometric scale છે, દરેક noncircular passage નો actual diameter નહીં.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Full circular pipe માટે hydraulic diameter inside diameter જેટલો અને hydraulic radius diameter ના ચોથા ભાગ જેટલો છે.Wetted perimeter માં fluid ને contact કરતો ભાગ જ લો, free surface નહીં.Fully wetted concentric annulus માટે outer-flow diameter minus inner-solid diameter એ Dh છે.Laminar noncircular flow માં shape dependence રહે છે; Dh મૂકી દરેક case માં 64/Re ન વાપરો.

title.en: Darcy/Fanning factors and the friction-factor chart

h.en: Darcy/Fanning factors and the friction-factor chart

body.en:
Definition and principle

A pipe friction factor expresses wall-friction loss in dimensionless form. The Moody chart convention is the Darcy factor fD; the Fanning factor fF is one-quarter of it. Mixing these conventions causes a factor-of-four error.

Important points

On the chart locate Reynolds number, select the relative-roughness curve in the turbulent region and read fD.The circular-pipe laminar branch is 64/Re and is independent of roughness under the usual fully developed assumptions. Transition is uncertain; do not invent a unique smooth interpolation. In fully rough turbulence, factor becomes nearly independent of Re but depends on relative roughness. State the convention with every result.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Wall-friction loss ને dimensionless સ્વરૂપે દર્શાવતો parameter Friction Factor છે.Moody chart સામાન્ય રીતે Darcy factor fD આપે છે.Fanning factor fF તેનો ચોથો ભાગ છે.બંને conventions ભેળવવાથી factor-of-four error આવે છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Chart પર Reynolds number શોધો, turbulent region માં યોગ્ય relative-roughness curve લો અને fD વાંચો.Circular-pipe laminar branch 64/Re છે તથા usual fully developed assumptions હેઠળ roughness થી independent છે.Transition uncertain છે; એક unique smooth interpolation બનાવી ન આપો.Fully rough turbulence માં factor લગભગ Re થી independent, પણ relative roughness પર dependent રહે છે.Result સાથે convention લખો.

title.en: Sudden expansion and sudden contraction losses
title.gu: Sudden Expansion અને Contraction ના Losses

h.en: Sudden expansion and sudden contraction losses
h.gu: Sudden Expansion અને Contraction ના Losses

body.en:
Definition and principle

A sudden enlargement separates the flow and creates recirculation/mixing, with mechanical-energy dissipation. A sudden contraction produces a vena contracta followed by re-expansion into the smaller pipe; that mixing causes a local loss.

Important points

For an idealised sudden expansion use upstream/downstream mean velocities in the Borda–Carnot expression. For contraction, use a documented K based on the smaller-pipe velocity or the stated vena-contracta approximation. Cc is jet contraction coefficient, not meter discharge coefficient. The pressure change between taps is not always equal to loss head because velocity heads also change.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Sudden enlargement થી flow separation, recirculation તથા mixing થાય છે અને mechanical energy dissipate થાય છે.Sudden contraction પછી vena contracta બને છે અને flow smaller pipe સુધી re-expand થાય છે; તે mixing થી local loss થાય છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Idealised sudden expansion માટે upstream/downstream mean velocities વડે Borda–Carnot expression લો.Contraction માટે smaller-pipe velocity આધારિત documented K અથવા stated vena-contracta approximation વાપરો.Cc jet contraction coefficient છે, meter discharge coefficient નહીં.Taps વચ્ચેનો pressure change હંમેશાં loss head નથી, કારણ કે velocity heads પણ બદલાય છે.

body.en:
Definition and principle

Elbows, tees, entries, exits and valves create local losses described by K times a specified velocity head. These are often called minor losses, but they may dominate a short complex system.

Important points

Use each fitting’s reference pipe velocity and its actual opening/geometry. K is not universal for all valve types or positions. Equivalent length is an alternative representation using the same factor convention and diameter. Do not count the same fitting once by K and again by equivalent length. Add losses for all pipe segments using their own velocities; do not apply one diameter to the whole network.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Elbows, tees, entries, exits તથા valves માં local losses થાય છે.તે K તથા specified velocity head ના product થી દર્શાવાય છે.તેને Minor Losses કહે છે, પણ short complex system માં તે મુખ્ય losses બની શકે છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

દરેક fitting માટે તેની reference pipe velocity તથા actual opening/geometry લો.બધા valve types/positions માટે K સમાન નથી.Equivalent Length એ same factor convention તથા diameter વાળું alternative representation છે.એક fitting ને K અને equivalent length બંનેથી double-count ન કરો.દરેક pipe segment માટે તેની velocity તથા diameter વડે losses ઉમેરો.

Aim and principle

h.gu: 15. Circular Pipe નો Darcy Friction Factor

body.en:
Aim and principle

Use corrected fully developed straight-pipe head loss to determine fD, then compare with Re/roughness behaviour.

Apparatus and connections

Known circular test pipe and tap span, pressure instrument, independent flow measurement and thermometer.

Supervised procedure

Record D, L, temperature and actual flow. Measure stable straight-run loss with proper elevation/manometer conversion. Compute mean velocity, Re and Darcy factor. Plot only measured points with uncertainty; label the Fanning conversion separately.

Precautions તથા Safe Fault-finding

Test span માં fittings/entrance losses હોય તો explicit correction લો.Darcy/Fanning convention લખો.64/Re ને turbulent correlation ન માનો.

body.en:
Task, report and evidence

Use actual supervised pipe-test readings, temperature/property sources and uncertainty to plot fD versus Re. Do not copy the theoretical reference chart and call it experimental. Work in a group and prepare about 5pages: objective/principle, labelled chart/model or method, comparison/calculations, findings/safety and conclusion/references. Record only genuine permitted photos, readings and presentation evidence.

Task, Report તથા Evidence

Actual supervised pipe-test readings, properties તથા uncertainty પરથી fD સામે Re plot કરો.Theoretical chart copy કરીને experimental ન કહો. Group માં આશરે 5pages નો report બનાવો: objective/principle, labelled chart/model અથવા method, comparison/calculations, findings/safety તથા conclusion/references.ફક્ત genuine permitted photos, readings તથા presentation evidence જોડો.

q.en: State necessary assumptions for Laminar Darcy factor—derivation.
q.gu: Laminar Darcy Factor—Derivation માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Same fully developed laminar circular-pipe assumptions as Hagen–Poiseuille. Darcy factor fD, not Fanning factor.
a.gu: Hagen–Poiseuille જેવી fully developed laminar circular-pipe assumptions. Darcy factor fD લો, Fanning factor નહીં.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Sudden expansion and sudden contraction losses.
q.gu: Sudden Expansion અને Contraction ના Losses ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A sudden enlargement separates the flow and creates recirculation/mixing, with mechanical-energy dissipation. A sudden contraction produces a vena contracta followed by re-expansion into the smaller pipe; that mixing causes a local loss. For an idealised sudden expansion use upstream/downstream mean velocities in the Borda–Carnot expression. For contraction, use a documented K based on the smaller-pipe velocity or the stated vena-contracta approximation. Cc is jet contraction coefficient, not meter discharge coefficient. The pressure change between taps is not always equal to loss head because velocity heads also change.
a.gu: Sudden enlargement થી flow separation, recirculation તથા mixing થાય છે અને mechanical energy dissipate થાય છે.Sudden contraction પછી vena contracta બને છે અને flow smaller pipe સુધી re-expand થાય છે; તે mixing થી local loss થાય છે. Idealised sudden expansion માટે upstream/downstream mean velocities વડે Borda–Carnot expression લો.Contraction માટે smaller-pipe velocity આધારિત documented K અથવા stated vena-contracta approximation વાપરો.Cc jet contraction coefficient છે, meter discharge coefficient નહીં.Taps વચ્ચેનો pressure change હંમેશાં loss head નથી, કારણ કે velocity heads પણ બદલાય છે.

q.en: State necessary assumptions for Sudden-expansion loss—derivation.
q.gu: Sudden-expansion Loss—Derivation માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Horizontal sudden expansion; steady incompressible flow; uniform section velocities; wall shear over mixing region neglected; annular step pressure approximated by p₁.
a.gu: Horizontal sudden expansion; steady incompressible flow; section velocities uniform; mixing region માં wall shear negligible; annular step pressure આશરે p₁ લો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Fittings,valves and total pipe-system losses.
q.gu: Fittings,Valves અને Total Pipe-system Losses ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Elbows, tees, entries, exits and valves create local losses described by K times a specified velocity head. These are often called minor losses, but they may dominate a short complex system. Use each fitting’s reference pipe velocity and its actual opening/geometry. K is not universal for all valve types or positions. Equivalent length is an alternative representation using the same factor convention and diameter. Do not count the same fitting once by K and again by equivalent length. Add losses for all pipe segments using their own velocities; do not apply one diameter to the whole network.
a.gu: Elbows, tees, entries, exits તથા valves માં local losses થાય છે.તે K તથા specified velocity head ના product થી દર્શાવાય છે.તેને Minor Losses કહે છે, પણ short complex system માં તે મુખ્ય losses બની શકે છે. દરેક fitting માટે તેની reference pipe velocity તથા actual opening/geometry લો.બધા valve types/positions માટે K સમાન નથી.Equivalent Length એ same factor convention તથા diameter વાળું alternative representation છે.એક fitting ને K અને equivalent length બંનેથી double-count ન કરો.દરેક pipe segment માટે તેની velocity તથા diameter વડે losses ઉમેરો.

q.en: Explain Pipe roughness,hydraulic radius and hydraulic diameter.
q.gu: Pipe Roughness,Hydraulic Radius અને Hydraulic Diameter યોગ્ય વ્યાખ્યા તથા જરૂરી સમીકરણો સાથે સમજાવો.
